patterns.title: Fail-Closed Guardrails, Normalized Schemas & Error-to-Regression-Test Loop
patterns.standard_playbook: Separate pure domain logic from HTTP/LINE adapters, enforce atomic SQL RPCs and PGlite PostgreSQL 17 tests, respect explicit GEMINI_MODELS without silent downgrades, and turn every caught defect into a DEV_LESSONS_LEDGER.json record plus an automated regression test.
patterns.guardrail_rule: Never fall open on database errors (return C06_DATABASE_DEGRADED_RESPONSE), never guess module exports or SQL column names without reading first, and never copy monorepo-only tests into the standalone deployment repo.
